classification.difficultyReason: Students choose additive decompositions from the diagrams, infer missing lengths from totals or matching ticks, and combine rectangular, triangular or fractional-cylinder volumes.

content.prompt: Calculate the volume of these prisms by addition. Round to 1 d.p. where appropriate.

spec.description: Unshaded stepped prism extending towards the upper left, with leader arrows identifying the lower ledge and lower step.
spec.mathematics: Front width 10 m; total height 2 m; lower height 1 m; lower ledge width 5 m; length 12 m.

spec.description: Rectangular prism topped by a semicylinder, with the front join visible and hidden edges dashed. Decorative source colours replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle width 8 cm and height 5 cm; semicircle diameter 8 cm; prism length 11 cm.

spec.description: Square prism adjoining a quarter-cylinder. Matching double ticks identify equal square sides; the quarter-circle centre has a right-angle mark.
spec.mathematics: Overall cross-section width 4 cm equals twice the common square side and quadrant radius; height 6 cm.

spec.description: Right triangular prism with a semicylinder attached along the hypotenuse. The shared diameter and hidden edges are dashed.
spec.mathematics: Triangle legs 3 cm and 4 cm; hypotenuse and semicircle diameter 5 cm; length 9 cm.

spec.description: Sloping-top prism with trapezoidal cross-section, two bottom right-angle marks and dashed hidden edges.
spec.mathematics: Parallel heights 1.1 m and 2.6 m, separation 2.3 m, depth 1.6 m.

spec.description: Cylinder on a square-based prism. Equal ticks establish the square base; rear bottom ellipse and hidden prism edges are dashed. Cylinder diameter made explicit in the editable prompt.
spec.mathematics: Square base side 8 cm; prism height 2 cm; cylinder height 5 cm and diameter 8 cm.
